title: Ran open year-end code-quality assessments with product teams
summary: I ran the software craftsmanship year-end assessments with product teams, reviewed their practices with them, reported the results back openly and suggested tools and next steps.
what_would_have_happened: Teams had no independent view of their engineering practices.
the_call: Assess practices with the team and share every finding with them.
what_i_did: Ran the assessments and the report-outs for the Software Center of Excellence, with tool and next-step suggestions.
what_changed: A magnetic resonance product team called the assessment open, transparent and informative, and thanked us for guiding them on code quality and processes all year.

quotes.text: The assessment was very open, transparent & informative and we indeed learnt new tools/technologies in the suggestions that came from SW CoE team directly.
